title: Connect GitHub
subtitle: Connect a GitHub account to start managing your repositories. You can add more accounts later.
keychainNote: Tokens are stored in your operating system's keychain — never in plain-text files.

tagline: One workbench for every repository you own — inspect, clean up and ship in bulk, safely.
